essence: The joined straight lattice receives the name straight lattice.
The four-corner-born lattice is remembered as elephant-eye.
The root bead is worshipped in the space between soft walls.
The leaf lattice with a variegated hole is desired.
The nandyāvarta lattice is to be led above the altar.
